Hi Marissa,

Thanks again for the demo last week — excited to get Redwood live. Finance needs a few quick items to set Redwood up as a vendor in our AP system before we can route POs and remit payments. Please see our checklist and a short list of questions below; I attached our Helio AP form (Helio_AP_Form.pdf) you can fill and return.

Quick checklist we need completed:
- Completed Helio AP form (company legal name, EIN, remittance address)
- W-9 (for US vendor tax purpose) or if non-US, certificate of foreign status
- Invoice sample showing PO number placement + VAT breakdown (if applicable)
- Bank remit details (ACH/IBAN) and SWIFT
- Preferred invoice email for automated ingestion (we support AP@heliohealth.com + Coupa vendor portal)

Questions:
1) We normally issue Net 60 by default to new vendors. Do you have a preferred payment term? Can you accept Net 45?
2) Do you require PO numbers on invoices for payment to flow? Our system will hold invoices without a PO.
3) Do you have VAT registration in the EU? We need VAT number and a line-item tax breakdown to apply reverse-charge where appropriate.

If you can return the completed AP form and a vendor invoice sample by end of week, I can fast-track the vendor record.

Attachment: Helio_AP_Form.pdf

Best,
Elena Ruiz
